## Changed: Window contacts no longer get a position sensor

Plain window contacts only report whether a window is open or closed, but they
also got a window position sensor that always showed unknown. That sensor is no
longer created; the open/closed binary sensor is unchanged, and window position
sensors keep their position sensor.

Existing installations keep the old sensor, which Home Assistant marks as no
longer provided. You can delete it under **Settings > Devices & services >
Entities**.

## Changed: Unreadable values show as unknown

When the System Access Point reports a value that can't be read, entities now
show unknown instead of `0`. This includes the `heating` and `cooling`
attributes of climate entities, so check automations or templates that compare
them with a number. Sensors that are unreadable at startup are still created
and update once the System Access Point reports a value; before, they were
missing until the integration was reloaded.

## Improved: Refreshing entities on request

The `homeassistant.update_entity` action on a wind sensor or air quality sensor
now reads only that entity's value, so the wind speed automation sends one
request per refresh instead of three. If a refresh fails on any entity, for
example while the System Access Point is unreachable, the integration logs one
warning instead of an error with a traceback; with debug logging enabled, it
also logs the full error.

[Refreshing entities on request](https://github.com/kingsleyadam/local-abbfreeathome-hass#refreshing-entities-on-request)
